description: 256-entry unsigned-8-bit camera pixel to signed INT8 input activation lookup table for V5-Spatial
hardware_implementation: Single-cycle 256x8-bit Block ROM (or distributed LUT RAM)

input_domain.description: Raw unsigned 8-bit camera RGB pixel values

output_domain.description: Quantized signed INT8 activations for Conv1 input

comparison_vs_naive_p_minus_128.significance: 50.0% of pixel values differ by +/- 1 LSB between exact PyTorch normalization and naive (P - 128). Implementing this LUT in FPGA fabric avoids this 1-LSB systematic distortion with zero DSP overhead.

verification_status: All 256 entries verified bit-exact against evaluate_v5_quantization.py
